summary: Assemble text with a consistent separator.
documentation: join inserts the separator between each string in an iterable. The separator is the string on which the method is called.
inputs: An iterable whose elements are strings.
caution: Non-string items raise TypeError; convert values deliberately when necessary.
scenarios: Build a readable list of selected services.
Combine cleaned text lines into an email body.
title: Format the service list
problem: Given an array of service-name strings, join them with ", ". Return an empty string for an empty list.
goal: Use str.join() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: The separator is ", "; call its join method.
